purpose: Development test of turret-conditioned poke insurance in lead9. Six declared counter policies, two lead opening-poke sizes, both seats,24 games. Off-route turrets on rounds1 or2 may trigger insurance through round3; a round3 turret becomes visible only in round4 and is a timing control. This full-policy comparison does not itself isolate feature causality. No reserved outcomes.
scope: Explicit development conditions. Paired deterministic games are not independent random samples.
